title: How to Add Categories to H1 Search Results Title for Posts
text:
## How to Add Categories to H1 Search Results Title for Posts
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000050248
If you wish to have your category show up in the H1 of your post search result, please follow along the steps below:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12041931751/original/boY16xhJcD0dZ3axPVHrTtxlIXXBlAaGeA?1539293510 | alt: ]
1. Go to Content - Edit Post Settings and select the feature you wish to add this to.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127318806/original/Z5UzKxw0EZNajz_gpe308QQMmVx7zbVUHg.png?1687449682 | alt: ]
2. Click on the Search Results Tab.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12071661036/original/CrabocMEVco7fim7POcFVUeXONKuKk0cNg.png?1577805932 | alt: ]
3. Copy and paste the code below into the Default H1 field.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12041932975/original/042sKp_8FqhwBm8D7iqYoEdHCHOBwtLIbw?1539296267 | alt: ]
This will also work when you search multiple categories at the same time:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12041931941/original/0AsUEHj6GIbrDiK7vw7KXB_XkKZtGLp4UQ?1539294002 | alt: ]
